What's the Vibe?
One number. Everyone knows it. Except you.
PartyGaming
🍎 Download on App Store▶ Google Play — Coming Soon
About
A pass-and-play party game for groups of 2 to 15. One player is the Guesser and everyone else sees a secret number from 1 to 10. The Guesser gives each person a category and works out the number from their answers. 550+ categories in 21 themed packs, Player Mode and Team Mode, and a bright party look with a vibe meter and a guess slider. Free to play: no ads, no purchases, no sign-up, and no Wi-Fi needed.
Highlights
550+ categories21 themed packs of prompts that actually get funny answers.
2-15 playersScales from a date night to a full house party.
Two modesPlayer Mode with rotating guessers, Team Mode with 2 to 7 teams and a scoreboard.
Free, every pack includedNo ads, no purchases, no account. Every category pack comes with the game.
